// 16x16 toroid, combinational next-state logic.
module GameOfLife256x1 (
    input clk,
    input load,
    input [255:0] data,
    output reg [255:0] q
);
    wire [255:0] next_q;
    reg [255:0] neighbours;
    integer i, j;
    always @(*) begin
        for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) begin
            for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin
                neighbours = q[(i-1+16)%16*16 + ((j-1+16)%16)] +
                             q[(i-1+16)%16*16 + ((j+1)%16)] +
                             q[(i-1+16)%16*16 + ((j+1)%16)] +
                             q[(i-1+16)%16*16 + ((j+2)%16)] +
                             q[(i+1)%16*16 + ((j-1+16)%16)] +
                             q[(i+1)%16*16 + ((j+1)%16)] +
                             q[(i+1)%16*16 + ((j+1)%16)] +
                             q[(i+1)%16*16 + ((j+2)%16)] +
                             q[(i+2)%16*16 + ((j-1+16)%16)] +
                             q[(i+2)%16*16 + ((j+1)%16)] +
                             q[(i+2)%16*16 + ((j+1)%16)] +
                             q[(i+2)%16*16 + ((j+2)%16)];
                next_q[i*16 + j] = (neighbours == 3) ? 1 :
                                    (neighbours == 2) ? q[i*16+j] : 0;
            end
        end
    end
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) q <= data;
        else q <= next_q;
    end
endmodule
